craft_evidence.owned: yes: own factory, Perry Street (formerly Magee Street entrance), Northampton, in use since 1891 per brand heritage page; factory shop at 27 Perry Street; brand photographs and documents the factory departments
craft_evidence.makers: yes (self): the brand is the maker; menu and collection copy state made in our very own factory in Northampton; driving shoes are stated Made in Italy (style editorial) with no maker named
craft_evidence.mills: no: no tannery named on PDPs or material guide (leather described by type only, e.g. cordovan naturally dyed in the tannery, tannery unnamed)
craft_evidence.madein: site level, not per PDP: 8 of 8 sampled men's PDPs across 8 categories carry no country in the product description; the factory-made-in-Northampton statement sits in site-wide menu/collection copy; driving-shoe PDP style block states Made in Italy
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: founded 1879 in Northampton by brothers-in-law James Crockett and Charles Jones; Magee Street factory 1891; 1935 wing and Perry Street entrance; family-owned, fifth generation joined 2006
craft_evidence.process: yes: In the Making page walks pattern cutting, clicking, closing, preparation, lasting, making, finishing and shoe room; more than 200 operations over 8 weeks; Goodyear welted; Hand Grade PDPs state hand-stitched uppers and bark-tanned soles
craft_evidence.reasoning: Crockett & Jones makes its shoes in its own Northampton factory (Magee/Perry Street since 1891), family-owned since 1879, and documents the process department by department on its own site, so maker and brand are the same thing for the core range. Against a clean 5: driving shoes are stated Made in Italy with no maker named, and no tannery is named; Sebastian may prefer 4 if the Italian line weighs.

ownership.owner: Jones family (founding family, independent); brand states the business is owned and managed by the founding family

opview: “To this current day, the business is owned and managed by the founding family, who emphasise quality and timeless style above all else.” — Crockett & Jones (the house, writing as itself), Crockett & Jones US site, Our Heritage page, Our Story
